title: Clone collision probability bound
statement: Let $E$ be a finite weighted constraint experiment, let $r$ be a natural number, and let $M>0$. Suppose every predicate selected by an outcome of $E$ has arity at most $r$. If each constraint occurrence is assigned independently and uniformly one of $M$ clones of each variable, then the probability that two positions in the resulting ordered query tuple receive the same variable-clone pair is at most $r^2/M$.
hypotheses_covered: Every outcome selects a predicate of arity at most $r$
